entities.name: CoaBC enzyme
observations: Sequence is 400 aa and matches reviewed Vibrio CoaBC homologs at 46–48% identity with approximately 98–99% coverage.

Homolog annotations assign two sequential coenzyme A biosynthesis activities: phosphopantothenate-cysteine ligation and phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylation; Mg2+ and FMN are annotated cofactors.

entities.name: RHEA:19397
observations: Homolog-annotated reaction: (R)-4'-phosphopantothenate + L-cysteine + CTP → N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine + CMP + diphosphate + H+; EC 6.3.2.5.

entities.name: RHEA:16793
observations: Homolog-annotated reaction: N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine + H+ → (R)-4'-phosphopantetheine + CO2; EC 4.1.1.36.
